subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR's sidebar image-sizing fix, ask that contributor for proof, or replace it with a narrow same-repo PR?
rationale: The source-visible fix is small, but the available implementation path is an open fork PR while the same-repo PR is already closed unmerged, so automation should not spawn another fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
options.body: Land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar markdown image cap change with focused Web UI proof.

options.title: Ask the fork PR for proof
options.body: Keep this issue open while requesting before-and-after browser evidence from the fork PR author.

options.title: Reject the sidebar scope
options.body: Close or detach the candidate patch only if maintainers decide the reported Web UI symptom needs a different proven root cause.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
recommendation.body: Land a maintainer-controlled version of the sidebar markdown image cap change with focused Web UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored and merged the Web UI styling change that introduced both compared image sizing rules.
